name: code-tabs-mdx
title: Code Tabs MDX
description: A slim dark code card that shows a single install command under two tab labels, so a reader can switch between variants and copy the one they need.
use: A setup step differs between tools and the reader needs to copy the matching command fast.
avoid: It expects exactly two code blocks; a single block falls back to a plain panel with no tabs.
a11y: Tabs use the shared tabs primitive, so arrow keys work; the copy tick is visual only and is never announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small dark grey rounded card with two tiny tab labels sitting along its top edge, one ringed by a thin outline. Below is one line of monospace text led by a faint dollar sign, with a small copy icon at the far right.
behaves: Choosing a tab name changes the outlined label and replaces the command line underneath. The copy icon writes the command to the clipboard and turns into a tick for about a second.
customise: Commands come from the code blocks you nest inside; the two tab names and highlight colours are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Two short commands of pre-highlighted HTML and nothing that animates.
